A NOTE FROM YOUR RIDER

A little witchcraft. A little steering.

  1. Drag left or right on the water to steer. Keyboard: A / D or arrow keys.
  2. Sail between the lantern posts. Collect the postmarks shown in the HUD. Both fork lanes count; the wider lane is easier.
  3. Hold BREW; tap JUMP. Candy and mint wisps refill your cauldron. Rose imps slow the boat. Jump low pumpkins, or steer around them. Give crossing brooms room.
  4. Meet a Boo Buddy. Sail close for a sweet bonus and a one-hit Boo Shield.
  5. Keep the parcel moving. The delivery needs 3 postmarks. Dock at Moonlit Manor, then tap to hand over the treats. Ghost Cove hides an optional candy cache.
  6. Try a midair trick. Tap JUMP again in the air, then steer onto the dotted star charm for a bonus. Space jumps on desktop; Shift boosts.
